weight_formula_and_default: raw=farmer.water_saving_weight (default 0.25 -> normalized 0.25 when forage null, 0.1667 when forage=0.50)
exact_input_features: gpm_annual_precip_2016_2025_mean_mm; nasa_power_annual_precip_2016_2025_mean_mm (alternate spread check only); water.availability; water.source; water.irrigation_system; crop_profiles.water_requirement_category & min_annual_rainfed_precip_mm
exact_scoring_rules_and_thresholds: BARE_FALLOW=0.60 fixed. STRICTLY_IRRIGATED: rainfed/none->0.0, drip->0.40, sprinkler->0.30, surface/other->0.20 (ignores abundant vs moderate and rainfall). Rainfed/Supplemental: headroom=clamp(-0.35,0.45,(precip-p_min)/300); RAINFED_SEMI_ARID_TOLERANT adds dry_edge=clamp(0,1,(600-precip)/100)*0.10 + 0.05; others add 0.05; irrig_active adds +0.05 (when source not rainfed/unknown, sys not none/unknown, avail in {moderate,abundant}); slot=clip01(0.40+headroom+cat_bonus+irrig_buf); strategy=mean(slots).
missing_data_behavior: If (gpm is None and power is None) OR (water_unconfirmed and has_strict_irrig): status=UNKNOWN, score=None, weight excluded & renormalized across remaining objectives. If one precip missing or water_unconfirmed on rainfed: status=PARTIAL, falls back to power_mm if gpm is None.
spatial_scope: Regional macro cell (~11 km GPM IMERG; ~55-69 km MERRA-2 POWER) + farmer water report
verified_limitations: Ordinal suitability index ONLY (not FAO-56 ETc minus effective precip); caps irrigated cash crops at 0.40 regardless of abundant drip supply; treats moderate and abundant water identically; _extract_water_context fallback bug reads 'water_source' instead of 'source' when field_profile=None.

exact_input_features: crop_profiles.som_contribution.direction; crop_profiles.root_depth_m; soilgrids.soc_0_30cm_g_kg & clay_0_30cm_pct (status toggle ONLY)
exact_scoring_rules_and_thresholds: Map each crop som_direction via _SOM_DIRECTION_SCORES (range 0.15 POTATO .. 0.95 VETCH_OAT, 0.90 FABA_BEAN, 0.58 WHEAT). Count distinct _root_depth_class (<0.6m shallow, <1.1m medium, >=1.1m deep; excluding none); if >=2 distinct classes add +0.05 diversity_bonus. Score=clip01(mean(slot_scores)+bonus).
missing_data_behavior: If soc_0_30cm_g_kg is None OR clay_0_30cm_pct is None: status=PARTIAL, score UNCHANGED. Zero numeric dependence on measured or modeled SOC/clay values.
spatial_scope: Non-spatial crop-KB formula + 250m SoilGrids presence toggle
epistemic_classification: AGRONOMIC_RULE_BASED + EXPERT_ASSUMPTION + HEURISTIC_ORDINAL_SCORE (250m SoilGrids used for PARTIAL toggle only)
verified_limitations: Neither SoilGrids SOC nor clay enters the numeric score formula (changing SOC 10->25 g/kg or None produces 0.0000 score delta); quantitative_t_c_ha_yr is null in all crop profiles.

exact_input_features: crop_profiles.nitrogen_fixation_potential_kg_n_ha; crop_category; SEQ_07_LEGUME_CEREAL_SYNERGY transitions; soilgrids.nitrogen_0_30cm_status (text note only)
exact_scoring_rules_and_thresholds: Per crop: FABA_BEAN (nfix dict 100-200 kg N/ha)->0.95; other Food Legumes/Pulses->0.72 (listed unquantified); VETCH_OAT->0.68 (unquantified); BARE_FALLOW->0.05; non-legumes->0.0. synergy_bonus=min(0.12, 0.06*count(SEQ_07 transitions)). Score=clip01(0.10 + 0.90*mean(n_slots) + synergy_bonus).
missing_data_behavior: SoilGrids nitrogen_0_30cm is permanently quarantined (UNVALIDATED_EXCLUDED) and excluded from math. If strategy uses unquantified legumes (Chickpea, Lentil, Vetch-Oat), status=PARTIAL while numeric weights 0.72/0.68 still apply.
verified_limitations: Site-agnostic formula: gives identical 0.6490 score on poor Belkheir soil and rich Bouchecouf soil; relies on heuristic constants (0.95/0.72/0.68) because quantitative N-fixation trials are missing for 3 of 4 legumes and all soil lab N/P/K is absent.

exact_input_features: crop_profiles.botanical_family; farmer crop_history most_recent_predecessor (when SEQ_10=PASS); sequence_rules SEQ_02..SEQ_06 & SEQ_10
exact_scoring_rules_and_thresholds: Build transition pairs: [predecessor->seq[0] if known] + adjacent seq pairs. Per pair: different botanical_family (no Mixed)->1.0; Mixed_Fabaceae_Poaceae with different crop->0.75; same crop/same pure family->0.0. Base=0.30 + 0.70*mean(transitions). Subtract warn_penalty: 0.12 per WARNING on SEQ_02/SEQ_04 or SEQ_06 CONSECUTIVE_1YR (0.04 if 2-yr hay cycle); subtract 0.45 per FAIL on SEQ_02..SEQ_05. Score=clip01(result).
missing_data_behavior: If history_assessment lacks verified T-1 predecessor (SEQ_10 != PASS): status=PARTIAL, transitions computed only across planned future slots (seq[0]->seq[1]...).
verified_limitations: Identical across all parcels regardless of climate/soil; when crop_history is null/[], SEQ_10 is UNKNOWN so T-1 carryover cannot penalize slot 1 (status=PARTIAL).

exact_scoring_rules_and_thresholds: base=mean(_EROSION_COVER_SCORES: 0.90 cereals/vetch-oat, 0.85 olive, 0.80 faba, 0.78 winter chickpea, 0.65 lentil, 0.62 sunflower, 0.60 spring chickpea, 0.40 tomato, 0.25 potato, 0.15 bare fallow). Subtract penalty: 0.20 if SEQ_08=FAIL, 0.10 if SEQ_08=WARNING. If dem_slope>=8.0% and base<0.70 add -0.10 slope_adj. Score=clip01(base-penalty+slope_adj).
missing_data_behavior: In current Guelma data, dem_slope_pct is permanently None (UNAVAILABLE_NOT_INTEGRATED), so slope_adj=0.0 always and status=PARTIAL on every field.
spatial_scope: Crop-KB cover hierarchy (terrain slope unintegrated -> effectively field-agnostic)
verified_limitations: Terrain runoff steepness (dem_slope_pct) and parcel slope hazard never influence any score because no DEM raster exists on disk; flat alluvial plain and steep hillside score identically.

weight_formula_and_default: raw=farmer.income_weight (default 0.20; ALWAYS excluded in API because status=UNKNOWN)
exact_input_features: Optional caller Python arg economic_data (NOT exposed in HTTP FieldAnalyzeRequest schema or UI); _QUALITATIVE_INCOME_TIERS (display-only)
exact_scoring_rules_and_thresholds: If economic_data supplies net_margin_per_ha OR (expected_yield_t_ha, price_per_t, cost_per_ha) for ALL crops in strategy: computes mean margin, later min-max normalized across eligible strategies in _normalize_income_scores_across_pool [0.10..1.00] (or 0.70 if equal). Otherwise score=None, status=UNKNOWN.
missing_data_behavior: Always status=UNKNOWN, score=None via API/UI (income_weight renormalized to 0.0 across active objectives). CRITICAL BUG: if farmer submits ONLY income_weight>0 without other core weights, omitted core weights zero out -> 0 active objectives -> NO_RECOMMENDATION.
spatial_scope: Not operational in API; requires external field/market budgets
epistemic_classification: UNKNOWN in API (only qualitative tier string shown); MEASURED_OR_OBSERVED only if caller Python budget injected
verified_limitations: Unreachable from HTTP /api/v1/fields/analyze or frontend UI; farmer's income_weight input in JSON/API silently has ZERO effect when paired with other weights and BREAKS recommendations (NO_RECOMMENDATION) if submitted alone.

weight_formula_and_default: raw=farmer.forage_value_weight (default None -> NOT_APPLICABLE; if supplied >0, normalized against active core weights)
exact_scoring_rules_and_thresholds: Inactive if forage_value_weight is None or <=0.0 (status=NOT_APPLICABLE, score=None). When >0.0: score=mean(_FORAGE_VALUE_SCORES: 1.0 VETCH_OAT, 0.55 BARLEY, 0.25 FABA_BEAN, 0.20 WHEAT, 0.15 pulses, 0.05 fallow/sunflower, 0.0 tomato/potato/olive).
missing_data_behavior: Null ('NOT_PROVIDED') and 0.0 keep objective NOT_APPLICABLE (0 active weight, omitted core weights kept at DEFAULT_FARMER_WEIGHTS).
verified_limitations: Qualitative biomass/fodder hierarchy only; independent of site rainfall, Vetch:Oat seed mix, or dry-matter t/ha yield.

exact_input_features: preferences.target_crop_ids; preferences.excluded_crop_ids; preferences.equipment_constraints; per-slot RULE_WATER_IRRIGATION_GATE & RULE_EQUIPMENT_CONSTRAINT_CHECK
exact_scoring_rules_and_thresholds: If excluded crop in sequence: returns 0.0 immediately. Otherwise: target_pts = 0.50*(matched_targets/total_eligible_targets) if targets else 0.45. ops_pts = 0.50 * mean(slot: 0.0 if water=FAIL or eq=FAIL; 1.0 if both PASS; 0.75 if water=PASS & eq=UNKNOWN; 0.45 otherwise -> applies to PASS water + WARNING eq). score=clip01(target_pts+ops_pts).
missing_data_behavior: When equipment_constraints is null (NOT_PROVIDED) or has unmodeled tags -> eq=UNKNOWN -> slot=0.75 & status=PARTIAL. When [] -> eq=PASS -> slot=1.0 & status=SCORED.
verified_limitations: PARADOXICAL EQUIPMENT BEHAVIOR: declaring equipment_constraints=['no_hay_baler'] sets WARNING (slot=0.45) on Vetch-Oat while upgrading Wheat & Faba Bean from UNKNOWN (0.75) to PASS (1.00), raising mean ops_pts from 0.75 to 0.8167 and INCREASING STRAT_SOIL_IMPROVEMENT score (+0.003642) vs null equipment; unmodeled tags keep strategy UNKNOWN.
